reviews.review_msg: Just don't take the class with him. No written example questions, over 200 iclicker questions in 6 weeks, lectures are the same as prelectures.
He's a good professor, but be prepared to do a lot of studying on your own. The prefecture and bridge questions are especially helpful for exam preparation

I did not see the light of day with him. Since it was intersession, for 3 weeks straight, 13 things were assigned each week. He is a nice guy, but he absolutely should not be teaching all he does is bombard us with iclickers. Do not take this course with him or as an intersession you will lose brain cells.

Would take his course again since his exams are just past exam questions but modified a bit. Teaching might not be his strong suit but if you read lecture notes and do practice problems you will be fine.

Get ready to learn physics on your own! This guy's lectures are literally re-reading the online pre-lecture work you did before class. However, attendance is mandatory and graded through clicker questions. This class took years off my life expectancy do not take during summer.

Dr. Lau spams you with iClicker and achieve homework that test basic comprehension, but do nothing for problem solving. Many students were left unprepared on the exams as a result. the grading scheme is lenient, but marking is strict. My advice is to just skip the lectures and grind past exams, tutorials, and assignments. Attend iClicker remotely.
